name: Image
desc: A single still, using the same look, lighting, weather and emotion libraries the films use.

fields.label: Subject
fields.default: a lone figure standing at the edge of an empty stadium
fields.hint: Name things. A quality like 'dramatic' does roughly nothing; 'floodlights behind, long shadow across wet grass' does the work.

fields.label: Look
fields.hint: Applied as a colour grade after generation, so it is exact - the one reliable way to get the colour you asked for.

fields.label: Engine
fields.hint: qwen wants prose and does photoreal or illustrated; anime wants danbooru tags. Feeding one the other's format returns abstract colour shapes.

note: Past about 2 MP this model duplicates composition - two horizons, repeated subjects. Generate at 1-2 MP and upscale 4x instead.

evidence.method: nothing has checked this card against pixels
